text: Robo: Your ship just got hit by solar flare, everything in every room is practically broken. Fix the engine in this ship until 100% to continue your journey.
Robo: Go to the Lab to check on AI in this ship.
Robo: ??/?!?!?;??!!! THIS SHIP IS BROKEN. GO TO THE SCREEN ??!/? IN EVERY ROOM, AND DRAW EARTH OBJECTS.
Astronout: Robo lost it’s memory of earth objects, I should retrain it before arriving to planet C-4.
Astronout: I should start fixing things and watchout with my energy.
Robo: Go to the Engine Room and start working on it.
Robo: Good! Just enough electricity from the engine to turn on the lamp.
Robo: Power outage, you must touch something wrong in the engine. Let’s keep rolling!
Robo: You need advance tools to continue fixing the engine, go to the Storage Room.
Robo: You got all you need, go back to the Engine Room and continue fixing.
Robo: Congratulations! My intelligence and the engine is in 100% now. Go to the Cockpit!
Robo: Having trouble drawing? Check the Album Book in the Sleeping Room for references.
Robo: Engine sealed. Need laboratory repair first.
Robo: Storage authorization depends on a stable 60 percent engine feed. Current access conditions are unmet.
Robo: Cockpit lock is functioning correctly. Complete full Engine and Intelligence restoration before entry.
Robo: You can add energy by drawing food in the kitchen.
Robo: All systems restored. Navigation control is responding. You brought us back online.
